$note.include: The four triangle stances; a card resolved to one of these keeps it.
$note.beats: Directed edges: the key beats every stance in its list.
$note.winnerMultiplier: The winner's damage (attack, smash) or Block (defend) is multiplied by this; the loser is unchanged.
$note.neutral: Stances that never win and never lose. They are not Idle: no extra draw, no extra damage taken.
$note.map: Old maneuver id to triangle stance. byEffect reads the card's effects instead.
$note.noManeuver: What a card with no maneuver resolves to.
$note.byEffect: In order: a card that deals damage, else one that gives Block, else the fallback stance.
$note.overrides: cardId to stance, for hand fixes; wins over map and byEffect.
$note.blockBonus: Which cards' Block takes winnerMultiplier (stances) and when (mode). anyEnemyIntent: the player's Block when any living enemy telegraphs a stance it beats; an enemy's Block against the player's current stance.
